profile.summary: TNTP (originally The New Teacher Project) is a national nonprofit that works with schools and school districts on education. It provides consulting to help create student-centered solutions, uses research and data to inform education policy, and partners with schools to hire, develop and keep a diverse teaching staff.

review.notes: ProPublica confirms The New Teacher Project Inc / TNTP Inc, EIN 13-3850158, a New York 501(c)(3) education nonprofit, and the TNTP contact page confirms the 500 7th Ave address, phone and consulting/research/talent services, matching the agenda's 'TNTP, New York, NY' and an academics no-cost agreement. The summary is neutral and supported; 'national' is not stated verbatim in the cited sources but is a minor, accurate descriptor.
